Welcome to My Classes

"I am Nilofar Naaz, a passionate Hindustani Classical vocalist committed to preserving India’s rich musical heritage while making music learning engaging and enjoyable for today’s generation. My teaching philosophy is rooted in strong raag clarity, sur perfection, rhythm discipline, and expressive singing. I focus on helping students build a solid classical foundation while confidently exploring Bollywood and semi-classical music. I gained national recognition as a contestant on Love Me India Kids (2018), a popular music reality show aired on &TV, uniquely known for its live audience voting from the audition rounds. The show featured renowned judges Guru Randhawa, Himesh Reshammiya, and Neha Bhasin, along with zonal captains who mentored the contestants. My performances and musical depth stood out, earning me a strong place among the country’s emerging vocal talents. My journey continued with selections in Sa Re Ga Ma Pa (till the Mega Round) and Indian Idol (up to Round 3), along with winning multiple state-level singing competitions. These experiences shaped my artistry and performance maturity, which I now pass on to my students through structured, joyful, and result-oriented training. Through my music classes, I aim not just to teach songs, but to create confident singers with strong fundamentals, musical sensitivity, and a deep respect for Indian classical music, while preparing them for modern performance platforms."
